title: nixos/prowlarr: add configurable dataDir and user/group options
reason: Applicable: real prowlarr module + wired test (prowlarr = handleTest ./prowlarr.nix {}; at head). Real diff adds genuinely new dataDir/user/group mkOptions, wired into systemd serviceConfig (User=cfg.user, Group=cfg.group) and ExecStart (-data=cfg.dataDir).
targets_toml: single target prowlarr, cfg_ident=cfg, option_prefix=[services,prowlarr], watch=[dataDir] (chosen as the single clearest new declaration among the three added; user/group not separately watched this pass).
